summary: Round 15 of colony-life is closed; this was the last round. The final tree is /home/user/scratch-r15e: HEAD 5151a98 with LARVA_P_REQ 0.8 (ruling R43), items 1-4 of direction 30, and this round's test restatements. All of it is in the live tree, and nothing was committed by me. On the year-one arm (15 round-10 hand-overs, against arm-y1P3b) the final tree gave 283 workers (280), 13 viable (13), median P 0.425 (0.450), median C 1.44 (1.43), median trip success 49.7% (47.4%), R27 held where P3b had it, and 14 of 15 runs had no lost worker (12). On the year-two arm (from round-13/cache-y2) it reached 88 workers at the second winter against 82 at winter 1 (y2-P3b: 83), with 2 of 5 colonies at >= 1.0 x (3 in P3b) and 0 at 1.5 x. On sweep 14's hand-overs, we #1 is viable again (its loss was the entrance-throat livelock, now fixed) and we #3 is still short of winter sugar. The first version of item 3 (no crumbs recorded while homing) cost two colonies their viability on the arm (r15d: 11 viable). It was found by targeted switch-off runs and replaced by variant e, which the integrator accepted in direction 30c. The ledger now has '## Round 15' with progress, results and tables, and '### Known limits at the close of colony-life'. DEVIATIONS.md has rows R43, D34 and D35. Three tests are newly red: App. E 23's carrion trail (from variant e), handoverStomach.verify (from R43) and ants/actions runner.test (already red on tree P).
causesRanked: 1. Entrance-throat delivery livelock (we #1, sweep 14). Workers spent 28.6% of their time delivering and the colony was not viable. A lone open voxel in the throat wall was the nav's nearest sample and read INF, so the chamber leg failed on the spot and updateDeliver re-requested it for ever. Over 2 gd from the hand-over, stuck deliverers went from mean 0.35 / max 2 to 0.

2. Item 3's first version (no crumbs while homing) cost we #3 and sg #3 their winter carbohydrate on the year-one arm: we #3 C 12.7 -> 3.35 for a need of 7.5, sg #3 13.9 -> 6.45 for 7.0; viable 13 -> 11. The no3 / nG / nN switch-offs isolated the crumb rule, and variant e restores both colonies (2 of 2).

3. Sugar trips broken off for prey on the way (we #3, sweep 14's hand-over): 29 of the 33 trips to a carbohydrate source that failed turned home 'item-collected', 78-168 BU short of the nectar. Fixing this alone leaves we #3 at 0.47-0.69 of its R27 need.

4. Round 14's mound-mask hole probe (single A/B runs against round 12's probe): trip success is 2, 15 and 11 points lower in kd #3, sg #2 and pp #3, and kd #3's brood flooding is 11 against 5. Not fixed (dropped by direction 30c).
5. Spoiled food spawned inside the chamber floor: kd #3 had 9 unreachable waste items against a tolerance of 3. Fixed; hygiene deaths are 4 on the final arm (5 in P3b).

notesForIntegrator: I read directions 30b and 30c late, after the r15e arms were already running, so their test items (30b items 3 and 4) were done afterwards. Five of the six R43 reds are restated. handoverStomach.verify was left red because it is an R2 outcome check, not a number.
Final tree = /home/user/scratch-r15e = live src (the tests restated afterwards aside). Nothing committed by me; git status shows DEVIATIONS.md, the ledger and six test files modified.
Variant e makes App. E 23 red: 22 deliverers, but no trail-established event. It is listed known-red. I kept variant e because the first version cost two colonies their viability.

Year-one arm r15e: viable 13 (sg #2 and pp #3 fail R27, as in P3b); median trip success 49.7%; 14 of 15 runs without a lost worker. Year-two r15e: 88 against 82 at winter 1, but only 2 of 5 colonies at >= 1.0 x.

Direction 30a's split for the founding was dropped. Larva food is read without the colony at hand (colony/life.ts larvaFood, species/derive.ts larvalCost) and also in economy.ts, queen.ts, index.ts and reproduction/gate.ts.
